status: Design only; no real transport, schema install, global limits or operational acceptance
basis: Accepted ADR-01/ADR-02; immutable source documents unchanged

outbox_contract.scope: A separate future delivery job type must be reviewed; existing synthetic.reference-check.v1 cannot deliver notices.
references_only: keyed recipient fingerprint and dedup scope
forbidden: encryption key material or provider credentials

envelope.storage: Dedicated private encrypted envelope, never outbox/audit/session/journal payload. Approved short lifetime, authenticated context binding to original operation/item/purpose/recipient/template, key version and expiry.
envelope.ownership: Custody, cipher/KMS, region, retention, expiry policy and decrypting transport principal unselected; fail closed if any required owner/policy missing.
envelope.access: Least-privilege sender fetches only its bound handle; deny missing/expired/revoked/mismatched envelope. Quarantine unresolved effects; retain redacted recovery evidence.
envelope.rollback: Disable new admission; retain unresolved operation/receipt evidence and encrypted envelopes per approved policy. Never automatically purge or resend.

retry_and_reconciliation: Persist immutable original send command before I/O and use accepted provider atomic idempotency or equivalent independently reviewed delivery semantics.
Lookup unknown or unavailable is unresolved; never automatic resend or success. Fresh signed complete-history noncommit is point-in-time evidence only.
Resend must preserve original intent/OTP lineage or create an explicitly authorized new operation; never reset failed-attempt or global-rate state by changing workers, sessions or request IDs.
Current recipient/purpose/notice approval, suppression, expiry, dedup and global throttle gates must all pass before send. Historical receipt is not current permission.
Consequential delivery tracks original attempt IDs, template version, timestamps, retry/failure state and redacted audit per FR-NOT-006.

global_throttle.scope: Shared durable admission across workers and instances, across start/resend/retry; enforce keyed recipient, purpose, intent/account and deployment-wide policy scopes. No unkeyed identity leakage.
global_throttle.atomicity: Atomic reservation with original operation/item and idempotent replay; no per-process fallback. Unknown reservation/send state needs reconciliation, never reset or bypass.
global_throttle.policy: Counts, windows, backoff, retry ceiling, expiry, budgets and escalation require approved policy. Unavailable/changed/revoked policy or clock/recovery uncertainty denies. No numerical production limits invented.

activation_acceptance: Institutional notices/G-05 and privacy/legal-basis approvals; sender/recipient purposes and approved template versions
Independent provider ownership/keys/generations/revocation, custody, hosting/region/budget and approved transport confidentiality
Two-instance shared admission/dedup with lost ACK, outage, restore rollback, key rotation/revocation and clock rollback; no cached fallback grant
SMTP/provider commit ambiguity explicitly characterized; local Mongo marker atomicity does not prove exactly-once email delivery
Independent recovery baseline and evidence survive database and provider restores; same-server logical namespaces insufficient

Database and private-file backups, including approved encrypted delivery envelope storage, are encrypted, access-controlled, regularly performed, monitored, copied off-site and periodically restored in documented tests (NFR-OPS-002); custody/retention/region remain approval gates.
not_implemented: Production throttling limits or resend/expiry policy

recipient_message_constraints.confidentiality: Recipient-facing messages, including decrypted send payloads, exclude confidential document contents, accusations, full identity records and private interview details (FR-NOT-004). Encryption at rest does not authorize confidential email content.
recipient_message_constraints.destinations: Messages provide task-relevant destinations; every destination exposing private details requires current authentication and record permission (FR-NOT-005). No public private-detail links or bearer shortcut.
recipient_message_constraints.acceptance: Review approved template versions and negative examples before transport activation; purpose/recipient binding does not replace content or destination review.
